Subject: EU-only processing & Private Connector — security evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week — MediSecure is very interested in Redwood for our new clinical summarization feature. Before we proceed to procurement we need to validate two things:

1) EU-only processing commitment: we need written confirmation that customer data for this project will be processed and stored only within the EU (we may accept specific EU cloud regions). We also need to understand how SCCs will be implemented (will Redwood sign the SCCs as processor?).

2) Network isolation: we require a private connector or VPC peering option so traffic to/from our environment doesn’t traverse the public internet. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports a private endpoint (reverse-proxy or private link) and provide the network/ops checklist and timeline to stand that up?

Finally, please attach the latest SOC 2 Type II report and the SIG/CAIQ matrix or equivalently detailed security evidence. We can share an NDA if needed, but procurement prefers to see these artifacts ahead of legal.

Can we get a consolidated reply by end of week? We’re aiming to close PO in September.

Best,
Anna
Anna Novak
Head of Procurement
MediSecure

Hi Anna — thanks for outlining everything so clearly. High-level answers up-front:

- EU-only processing: Yes — Redwood can run customer workloads exclusively in EU regions for Private deployments. For Hosted customers we offer region routing; for guaranteed EU-only residency and isolation we recommend Redwood Private (VPC/private connector or on-prem). Redwood acts as data processor and we sign the EU SCCs as part of our standard DPA.

- Network isolation: We support a Private Connector (customer VPC to Redwood private endpoint) and cloud-provider private link options. Typical delivery is an engineering/ops project that takes ~3–5 weeks depending on network approvals and region.

I’ve attached our SOC 2 Type II report and our SIG assessment spreadsheet for your review. Marcus (cc’d) — can you confirm the network checklist items Anna will need (IP ranges, TLS/cert model, routing, NAT, expected ports, and whether a VPN or Private Link is preferred)?
Neha (cc’d) — please flag any SCCs / DPA items that would require explicit legal review beyond the standard template.

Next steps:
- Anna: confirm preferred EU region (e.g., eu-west-1, europe-west1) and the MediSecure network contact for firewall/IP whitelisting.
- We’ll draft a DPA with SCCs and open a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks — attaching: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf; Redwood_SIG_Assessment_2026.xlsx; VPC_Private_Connector_Specs.pdf

Best,
Olga Petrov

Hi team — forwarding Anna's note with a few technical clarifications we should confirm with the customer before we commit to the 3–5 week timeline: 

On Wed, 18 Aug 2026 at 11:03, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [excerpted] Typical delivery is an engineering/ops project that takes ~3–5 weeks depending on network approvals and region.

Questions for MediSecure (to confirm implementation path):
- Which cloud provider and specific region do they require (AWS eu-west-1, GCP europe-west1, Azure West Europe)?
- Do they expect egress to be blocked entirely from our hosted control plane, or is routing allowed through a dedicated transit gateway?
- Will they provide a customer-managed Private Link endpoint, or do they want Redwood to provision the peer connection?
- Expected traffic profile: peak concurrent requests and average QPS (we need this for autoscaling policy and private NAT sizing).
- Certificate model: will they accept Redwood-managed TLS certs on the private endpoint, or require mutual TLS with their client certs?

Implementation notes (prelim):
- We support Private Link + VPC peering + S2S VPN options; Private Link preferred for shortest maintenance burden.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a small set of egress IPs per region; for fully private we can route via a customer-owned transit gateway.

I recommend we collect the answers above and then schedule a 30-min network workshop with Marcus + our infra on-call + MediSecure network lead.

Thanks,
Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
